text_block_list.text:
Ever since falling ill in spring, 
Aston Machan was seen less and less, and 
spoken of just as rarely—

Lately, she had vanished from sight 
entirely. 
When was the last time anyone saw her...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She isn't at the academy, nor any of the 
places she usually visits. 
What's worse... nobody's even talking 
about her lately.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Not a single person brings her up. 
It's as if everyone's forgotten all about 
Ma-chan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to ward off Ma-chan's misfortune. 
No matter what happens, that will never 
change!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If this three-arrow rehearsal succeeds— 
No, I'm going to make sure it does!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, while I'm out there trying, 
would you call out my name?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Human prayers give Umamusume strength. 
With people's prayers, Umamusume can work 
miracles. 
—So, please.
choice_data_list:
Of course. I'll shout loud enough for you 
to hear!

Of course. I'll shout loud enough for you 
to hear!

text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet notches the arrows. 
With singular focus, pouring all her 
resolve into them.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —In-yo-i!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, one missed...! 
A sacred mountain really is completely 
different from the practice grounds.)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No. It wouldn't be worth doing without a 
challenge like this! 
—All right, from the top!

On an unstable, misty sacred mountain, 
hitting all three targets at once 
again and again is a monumental feat. 
—Yet I watch and wait, believing in her. 
She can do this.
choice_data_list: Scarlet!! You've got it next time!!
Scarlet!! You've got it next time!!

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text: Scarlet-san, keep at it—!

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructors
text_block_list.text:
"Show 'em your guts, Scarlet-chan!" 
"Nice fight, Scarlet-san!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*... 
...Ow...
choice_data_list:
The skin on your fingers is peeling... We 
need to get ointment on that!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. 
I'm starting to get the hang of it. 
I'm going again...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *gasp*... gh...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(...Move! Move— 
My hands, my legs...! 
This is no time to be standing still...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(...Out of breath. Hurting. 
Refusing to lose, squeezing out every last 
ounce of strength—)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(...And just when my legs grew heavy, 
right then—)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(...I can hear it...! 
Above all else, your voice!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Believing that I can do it. 
Those prayers, those wishes—they're 
pushing me forward!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I am—Daiwa Scarlet!! 
The Umamusume who wards off misfortune and 
sends our wishes to the heavens!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about cuts! Who cares about 
exhaustion! 
I'm going to make the number one miracle 
happen!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I will make it come true...! 
Like hell I'm stopping here!! 
You said it yourself, didn't you...?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —ASTON MACHAN!!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —...Scarlet...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*... 
D-Did I do it...? 
Did I...!!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Human and Umamusume, accomplished 
together. 
...If it is the two of you, the real 
ceremony will surely succeed.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ma-chan...!? 
You're... really here, right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. 
Everyone's ultra-super mascot, 
Ma-chan is right here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I see... 
...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was watching your yabusame just now. 
...It was so dazzling, it almost makes me 
jealous. 
Ma-chan can't afford to fall behind, can 
she?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I shall shine even brighter than Scarlet 
and become a mascot etched forever into 
everyone's memories. 
...Brace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Etched into everyone's memories... 
—...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... bring it on! 
—Because the one who's going to be number 
one is me!
